svg.title: Thousand-Bough Isle top-down layout
svg.text: Thousand-Bough Isle: top-down layout (world metres, north up)
approach lane from Meridian (±30 m clear)
canopy r 60 (open inside r 26; high crown NE to y 77)
Inset: the tree village (x 1940–2090, z −1650 to −1500)
3 (Saffi, y 18.5) and 9 (Elder, y 50.5) stand one above the other.
NPC stop (1 Tamsin, 2 Lyra, 3 Saffi, 4 Oak, 5 Fen, 6 Ines, 7 Rook, 8 Pip, 9 Elder)
chest C2.1 Booth Pools, C2.2 behind Great Falls
rope bridges (R3 dashed: opens in the twist)
hero-shot cameras (H1 off map to the SW; H9 is from Meridian)
Helix stair: clockwise, r 15.5–19.5, 12 m rise per turn, from bearing 200 (y 18.5) to bearing 80 (y 50.5).
Decks branch outward from the helix; nothing crosses the stair band within 4.5 m above it.
Crew houses aren't walkable; their basket lifts rise from the three wheels when water reaches them.
